Definition: of Hebrew origin (compare H5809); Azor, an Israelite:--Azor.
BiblicalUsage: Azor is a name in the genealogy of Jesus — the father of Sadoc, the son of Eliakim, five generations before Joseph. Matthew lists him between the exile and the birth of Christ, and that is all we know of him: a link in the chain that brought the Messiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the links in the chain matter as much as the famous names, because without Azor there is no Sadoc, and without the chain there is no coming of Christ.
